title: RTT 估计与 RTO 计算：Jacobson/Karels 与 Karn 算法
expected_output:
=== RTT estimation (Jacobson/Karels), alpha=1/8, beta=1/4 ===
  #  sample(s)  retrans     RTTs     RTTd      RTO note
  1      0.100        -    0.100    0.050    0.300
  2      0.120        -    0.103    0.043    0.273

  5      0.180        -    0.122    0.050    0.321

  8      0.140        -    0.122    0.037    0.271

=== Karn's algorithm ===
  a retransmitted segment MUST NOT be used for RTT sampling
  reason: the returning ACK could belong to either the original or the retransmission
  including it would corrupt RTTs/RTTd (ambiguous ACK problem)
  fix: ignore the sample, and only re-sample after a segment is ACKed without retransmission

=== why RTO = RTTs + 4*RTTd ===
  RTTs is a smoothed mean (exponentially weighted moving average)
  RTTd is a smoothed mean absolute deviation (a cheap stand-in for std-dev)
  RTO ~ mean + 4*sigma  => the timeout lies far in the upper tail,
  so spurious timeouts are rare while genuine losses are still detected promptly
code:
print("=== RTT estimation (Jacobson/Karels), alpha=1/8, beta=1/4 ===")
ALPHA, BETA = 1 / 8, 1 / 4
rtt_s, rtt_d = 0.0, 0.0
first = True
samples = [(round(0.10 + 0.02 * (i % 5), 3), False) for i in range(12)]
samples[6] = (0.250, True)      # 第 7 个样本：发生了重传 -> Karn 算法：不采样
samples[9] = (0.105, False)

print(f"{'#':>3} {'sample(s)':>10} {'retrans':>8} {'RTTs':>8} {'RTTd':>8} {'RTO':>8} note")
for i, (sample, retrans) in enumerate(samples, 1):
    if retrans:
        print(f"{i:>3} {sample:>10.3f} {'YES':>8} {'-':>8} {'-':>8} {'-':>8} Karn: skip sampling")
        continue
    if first:
        rtt_s, rtt_d = sample, sample / 2
        first = False
    else:
        rtt_d = (1 - BETA) * rtt_d + BETA * abs(sample - rtt_s)
        rtt_s = (1 - ALPHA) * rtt_s + ALPHA * sample
    rto = rtt_s + 4 * rtt_d
    print(f"{i:>3} {sample:>10.3f} {'-':>8} {rtt_s:>8.3f} {rtt_d:>8.3f} {rto:>8.3f}")

print()
print("=== Karn's algorithm ===")
print("  a retransmitted segment MUST NOT be used for RTT sampling")
print("  reason: the returning ACK could belong to either the original or the retransmission")
print("  including it would corrupt RTTs/RTTd (ambiguous ACK problem)")
print("  fix: ignore the sample, and only re-sample after a segment is ACKed without retransmission")
print()
print("=== why RTO = RTTs + 4*RTTd ===")
print("  RTTs is a smoothed mean (exponentially weighted moving average)")
print("  RTTd is a smoothed mean absolute deviation (a cheap stand-in for std-dev)")
print("  RTO ~ mean + 4*sigma  => the timeout lies far in the upper tail,")
print("  so spurious timeouts are rare while genuine losses are still detected promptly")
